cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama Senate District 31 since November 2022. He owns and is president of SanBuck Insurance, has a degree in agricultural science from Auburn University, and previously served as Coffee County Commissioner for District 1, according to Wikipedia.
cands.gaps: We found no documented actions or stated positions from Carnley on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land protection, immigration and H-1B, police and public order, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The Ballotpedia list of bills he sponsored did not load, so we could not cite any specific bill. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys. We found no news reports of controversies and no listed endorsements for 2026. We could not find when, or whether, he moved within Alabama. The sources do not say where he was raised, only where he finished high school.

qual.background: State senator since November 2022, former Coffee County Commissioner for District 1, and owner/president of SanBuck Insurance. He has served on the Choctawhatchee, Pea, and Yellow Rivers Watershed Management Authority.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service in the state Senate plus local elected office and business ownership. No chamber leadership post appears in the sources, and committee seats were not counted.
